item.title: Vehicle failed its smog check? You may qualify for a $975 repair voucher
item.description: Do you have a pre-2006 vehicle that failed its most recent smog check? If so, you may qualify for an up to $975 repair voucher from Smog Free Clark County to help get your vehicle back on the road.

item.title: Clark County district attorney drops charges in Chinatown shooting, stabbing
item.description: The Clark County district attorney has dropped the charges against a man who was allegedly involved in a shooting and stabbing at a Las Vegas Chinatown karaoke bar.

item.title: Las Vegas among least hard-working cities across U.S.: Study
item.description: The three cities that make up the Las Vegas valley are among the least hard-working cities in the nation, a new study showed.

item.title: Lamar Odom leaves rehab following treatment after Nevada DUI charge
item.description: Former NBA star Lamar Odom has completed a rehabilitation program weeks after seeking treatment following his Nevada DUI arrest, according to new reports.

item.title: Clark County septic tank rules clarified after 1K+ neighbors show up
item.description: After over a thousand Clark County neighbors showed up to a health district meeting, officials are clarifying the proposed rule changes over septic tanks.

item.title: Grand jury indicts Las Vegas club promoter on DUI, hit-and-run charges for crash involving 2-year-old
item.description: A Clark County grand jury has indicted a Las Vegas club promoter accused of driving drunk, crashing into a family on a sidewalk and driving off. The crash injured a mother and 2-year-old child.

item.title: Las Vegas teacher admits to relationship, police say
item.description: A music school teacher accused of having a sexual relationship with a 16-year-old student was discovered by her older sister, according to documents 8 News Now obtained.
